title: Affected
line: Find the tests that can reach a changed file.

beats.caption: You ask which tests reach the current changes.
Affected traces imports back to the test file.
beats.label: pi-affected

beats.caption: The report suggests a command you can run.

takeaway.title: Give the change a check
takeaway.line: Use the suggested test when the import graph can trace the change.

title.text: When you edit one helper, you can use the project’s imports to find a test worth running first.

scene.text: This change touches the greeting helper. Slash affected follows the imports back to the test that exercises it. It gives you a command for that selection.

takeaway.text: Run the suggested command to check the change. If the graph is incomplete, Affected will point you to a wider check.
